_README: Protected values in dashboard/data.js. Checked by scripts/ci_validate_datajs.py and tests/test_baseline_invariants.py. The point is that these cannot change SILENTLY -- a deliberate change means editing this file and saying why, which shows up in review. Seeded from the live data.js, never hand-typed.

_classes.frozen_history: A closed financial year. History does not change. Exact equality; a mismatch is a defect in the build, never an update.
_classes.approved_current: A business-approved figure for the CURRENT FY. Exact equality. Changing it needs the named owner's approval and a new FY key.
_classes.tracked_universe: Legitimately evolves (stores open and close). Not frozen: the test asserts it is present, positive, and equal to the value recorded here -- so a refresh is a deliberate edit, not a silent drift.

checks.why: FY26 closed Mar-26. Every build must reproduce it.

Verified MT chain count. Update deliberately when a chain is added or retired. CORRECTED 2026-09-14 from 20 to 17, then to 16: universe.n_chains previously had no producing code path anywhere in this repo (an orphaned field -- any full rebuild would have silently dropped it), and the prior 20 coincided exactly with universe.by_chain's old, undisclosed [:20] truncation length, not a real verified count. Root QC found 18 of UniverseMT.csv's 36 raw Chain Name values were actually distributor Ship-To/DC billing codes, not chains (confirmed against PowerBI/SeedData/Masters/ShipToMaster.csv's own governed Primary Chain / Chains Served columns -- e.g. "G.V Enterprises" serves Apollo, D-Mart, Lulu and Pothys, it is not its own chain). Reclassifying 16 of those 18 into their governed Primary Chain first yielded 17 ("RRL-FOC-Sample", 1 store, had no ShipToMaster match and stayed its own label). Further evidence found: ShipToMaster.csv carries a governed "Reliance Retail Limited-FOC" entry (Direct, Primary Chain = Reliance Retail) -- the same entity type (RRL = Reliance Retail Limited, FOC = free-of-charge/sample door) -- so RRL-FOC-Sample was folded into Reliance Retail too, yielding 16 real distinct chains reconciling exactly to all 426 active stores with no truncation. See scripts/build_dashboard_data.py universe_block()/CHAIN_ALIASES and docs/PROJECT_STATE.md for the full trace.
